trial: M2 robustness of the M1e reading

rules.question: does M1e's reading survive per-gene decomposition, leave-one-out, a non-degenerate offset and a change of seed
rules.may_not_change_M1e: if a diagnostic contradicts M1e, the contradiction is reported and M1e's reading stands beside it
rules.equivalence: the null on the AT2 ATAC arm is reported as the largest effect the frozen rule would have hidden, three sham standard deviations, not as an absence of movement
